question: How much residual moisture did the water-processed NMC532 cathode lose between 20 °C and drying at 120 °C, and how does its final value compare with the NMP-processed cathode dried at 100 °C?
rendered:
According to the text on page 9, the residual moisture in the NMP-processed NMC532 cathode was reduced to 87 ppm after drying at 100 °C under vacuum for 2 h. In comparison, the residual moisture was 160 ppm for the water-based one after drying at the same conditions, but it was further reduced to 112 ppm and 47 ppm by increasing the drying temperature to 110-120 °C, respectively.

Therefore, the water-processed NMC532 cathode lost 53 ppm (160 - 47) of residual moisture between 20 °C and drying at 120 °C, and its final value (47 ppm) is lower than the NMP-processed cathode dried at 100 °C (87 ppm).
